boundaryNote: Exact implementation commit containing the v0.0.8 recoverable-account foundation, installation/session controls, source access-key rotation, documentation, and deployed migrations.

summary.en: Protect the Zona you have built, bring it to a new phone, and change a sender key without starting over.
summary.zhHant: 保護你建立好的 Zona，換手機後也能繼續使用，傳送端金鑰亦可隨時安全更換。

items.titleEn: Pick up on a new phone
items.bodyEn: Protect your Zona, sign in again, and your sources and recent inbox are ready to meet you.
items.bodyZhHant: 保護你的 Zona，再次登入後，來源和最近的通知都會準備好迎接你。

items.bodyEn: Choose email, Apple, Google, or GitHub, then add another method for extra peace of mind.
items.bodyZhHant: 你可以選擇電郵、Apple、Google 或 GitHub，也可多加一種方式，令帳戶更安心。

items.titleEn: Change a key, keep everything else
items.bodyEn: Give scripts and agents their own keys, replace one safely, and keep the same source name, sound, filters, and history.
items.bodyZhHant: 腳本和代理程式可以各用一把金鑰，安全更換其中一把時，來源名稱、提示音、篩選和記錄都保持不變。
